nodes.label: Bank Derivation (Core.bank)
nodes.rationale: Bank = colours[].have minus buy-in mixes plus cash-out mixes; mixless buy-ins, loose other chips and the house pile do not move it.

nodes.label: Core.bankMix Even-Spread Mix with Slot Reserve
nodes.norm_label: core.bankmix even-spread mix with slot reserve
nodes.rationale: Picks the exact mix closest to an even value spread while taking at most 1/slots of each colour's stock; slots relaxed by binary search to minSlots so the bank keeps a rebuy for everyone.

nodes.label: Chip-Leader Buy-in Cap (leaderCheck)
nodes.rationale: App can't see live stacks so it asks the host only for bigger-than-standard buy-ins once someone else has bought in.

nodes.label: Game Config (mode, handCents, handChips, cv, fee, blinds)
nodes.norm_label: game config (mode, handcents, handchips, cv, fee, blinds)
nodes.rationale: handChips/handCents field names kept from old 'hand' wording so old saves load unchanged.

nodes.label: Minimum-Payments Settlement (Core.settle)
nodes.rationale: Exact up to 20 non-zero players; above that falls back to a single greedy group, valid but not guaranteed minimal.

nodes.label: Rake (basis points, min pot, house pile)
nodes.norm_label: rake (basis points, min pot, house pile)

nodes.label: Rendering Model (App.render rebuilds main)
nodes.rationale: Whole <main> rebuilt from state on every commit; sheets live outside main and call api.refresh(); focused inputs update derived text in place; use U.append because native append prints 'null'.

nodes.label: Running Checks via VS Code Bundled Node
nodes.norm_label: running checks via vs code bundled node
nodes.rationale: Node isn't on PATH; Code.exe with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; GUI exe so use Start-Process -Wait and file outputs.

nodes.label: Saved Chip Sets (keep() upsert)
nodes.rationale: No preset boxed sets; every edit upserts into db.chipSets without re-render; values stored in chips so a set doesn't change with the rate.

nodes.label: More Options Extras (switches off by default)
nodes.norm_label: more options extras (switches off by default)

nodes.label: CLAUDE.md graphify Rules
nodes.rationale: Run graphify query/path/explain before grepping or reading source; run graphify update . after code changes; large graph.json diffs are expected.

nodes.label: Chips During Game, Money in Setup/Results
nodes.norm_label: chips during game, money in setup/results

nodes.label: CSS Colour Tokens and Dark Mode
nodes.norm_label: css colour tokens and dark mode
nodes.rationale: Colours are :root tokens in css/style.css; dark mode defined twice (prefers-color-scheme guarded and data-theme=dark) and both blocks kept identical; Apple-style grouped surfaces with one blue accent.

nodes.label: Every UI String Through T()
nodes.rationale: English text is the key; add a zh entry to I18N.zh and run the i18n check which must report missing 0.

nodes.label: Money Is Integer Cents, Chips Whole Numbers
nodes.norm_label: money is integer cents, chips whole numbers
nodes.rationale: Never use floats for money; chip value config.cv is whole cents; percentage rake stored as basis points (config.fee.bps) and floored to whole chips.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass for Navigation Layer Only
nodes.norm_label: liquid glass for navigation layer only
nodes.rationale: .glass goes on top-bar button group, floating tab bar and toasts; content stays solid; never glass on glass; tab bar hides while a sheet is open; keep reduced-transparency and contrast fallbacks in sync.

nodes.label: Plain Scripts, No Build Step (IIFE Globals)
nodes.norm_label: plain scripts, no build step (iife globals)
nodes.rationale: Each file is an IIFE attaching one global loaded in fixed order by index.html; no import/export, bundlers or npm runtime deps so opening index.html from disk keeps working.

nodes.label: Never Credit Claude in Git
nodes.rationale: Commits, merges and PRs must not include Co-Authored-By Claude or any Anthropic attribution; commit as repo owner fei7fei only; overrides default attribution instructions.

nodes.label: Pure Maths Only in Core
nodes.rationale: js/core.js has no DOM or localStorage access and runs in browser and Node (module.exports) so anything testable lives there with tests in tests/core.test.js.

nodes.label: Results Sum to Zero; No Pay-and-Receive
nodes.norm_label: results sum to zero; no pay-and-receive

nodes.label: Local-Only Data (no server, no account)
nodes.rationale: Everything saved in the phone's browser for this site only; lost on clearing data unless exported via Settings > Export.
